pointers.Original Text: いつものようにホスト部部室に顔を出す。
pointers.New Text:
Show up at the Host Club room as
usual.
pointers.MT Text:
Show up at the Host Club room as
usual.

pointers.Original Text: 借金返済完了までの長い道のりを、お客様支持率を上げて完済すれば良いだろう？
pointers.New Text:
Isn't it just a long road to
paying off my debts if I raise
customer support?
pointers.MT Text:
Isn't it just a long road to
paying off my debts if I raise
customer support?

pointers.Original Text: みたいなことを鏡夜先輩に言われて現在もホスト部で接客に励んでいる。
pointers.New Text:
Kyoya-senpai said that. Now I
work here.
pointers.MT Text:
Kyoya-senpai said that. Now I
work here.

pointers.Original Text: 自分としては普通に働いて返していけばいいかなあとは思うんだけど、このホスト部特有の空気に慣れちゃったせいか……。
pointers.New Text:
I thought I could just work and
pay it back, but maybe I've
gotten used to this club...
pointers.MT Text:
I thought I could just work and
pay it back, but maybe I've
gotten used to this club...

pointers.Original Text: （ここにいるのが楽しい、なんて絶対末期だよね）

Having fun here means I'm
doomed. So, as usual, I came to
the clubroom...
pointers.MT Text:
Having fun here means I'm
doomed. So, as usual, I came to

pointers.Original Text: まあ、そんなわけで今日も今日とて部室に来たんだけど……。
いつもだったら必要以上に歯の浮くセリフで接客をしている環先輩や、営業にいそしむ鏡夜先輩。
pointers.New Text:
Usually Tamaki-senpai serves
with flowery lines, while
Kyoya-senpai focuses on sales.
pointers.MT Text:
Usually Tamaki-senpai serves
with flowery lines, while
Kyoya-senpai focuses on sales.

pointers.Original Text: それに甘い匂いが漂ってくるハニー先輩もそれに付き従うようなモリ先輩も見当たらない。
pointers.New Text:
I don't see Honey-senpai or
Mori-senpai either.
pointers.MT Text:
I don't see Honey-senpai or
Mori-senpai either.

pointers.Original Text: 「殿も鏡夜先輩もハニー先輩もモリ先輩もみーんな用事があってこれないってさ」
pointers.New Text:
Lord Tama-chan, Otori-senpai,
Honey-senpai, and Mori-senpai
are all busy and can't come.
pointers.MT Text:
Lord Tama-chan, Otori-senpai,
Honey-senpai, and Mori-senpai
are all busy and can't come.

pointers.Original Text: 「殿と鏡夜先輩は家の用事。ハニー先輩はチカの試合を見に行ってるし、モリ先輩はそれの付き添いでいないわけ」

Tamaki and Kyouya have family
business. Honey and Mori are
away.
pointers.MT Text:
Tamaki and Kyouya have family
business. Honey and Mori are
away.

pointers.Original Text: 「じゃあ今日は自分と光、馨だけってこと？」
pointers.New Text:
So it's just me, Hikaru, and
Kaoru today?
pointers.MT Text:
So it's just me, Hikaru, and
Kaoru today?

pointers.Original Text: 「殿もさー、人手がないんだから臨時休業すれば良いのに、ホスト部を求めてる女性がいるのならば！　とか言っちゃってさ」
pointers.New Text:
Tamaki should close! Few people
left! But girls still want Host
Club, he says.
pointers.MT Text:
Tamaki should close! Few people
left! But girls still want Host
Club, he says.

pointers.MT Text: Still, he's the president, you know.

pointers.Original Text: 「鏡夜先輩にも言ってみたんだけど、殿が言うのならば実施しろみたいな感じでさ」
pointers.New Text:
I told Kyoya-senpai too, but he
said something like 'If you say
so, then let's do it.'
pointers.MT Text:
I told Kyoya-senpai too, but he
said something like 'If you say
so, then let's do it.'

pointers.Original Text: 「そろそろお客様も来ると思うから、そうゆうセリフは思っていても口に出さないでよね」
pointers.New Text:
Since customers will be here
soon, don't say such things out
loud, okay?
pointers.MT Text:
I think our customers will be here
soon, so even if you're thinking it,
don't say stuff like that out loud.

pointers.Original Text: 天上天下唯我独尊みたいな光と馨。その上ものすごく飽きっぽい２人だからやーめた、とか接客を放り出さないと良いんだけど……。
pointers.New Text:
Hikaru and Kaoru act like the
world revolves around them, and
they get bored fast too...
pointers.MT Text:
Hikaru and Kaoru act like the
world revolves around them, and
they get bored fast too...

pointers.Original Text: 「冗談だよ、じょーだん。ホスト部での仕事は真面目にやるよ」
pointers.New Text:
Just kidding, just kidding. I'll
take my work in the Host Club
seriously.
pointers.MT Text:
Just kidding, just kidding. I'll
take my work in the Host Club
seriously.

pointers.Original Text: 「売りのシンメトリーな兄弟愛でちゃんとやり遂げるさ」
pointers.New Text:
Let's pull off this act of
symmetrical brotherly love.
pointers.MT Text:
I'll pull it off with the
symmetrical brotherly love act.

pointers.Original Text: 「ハルヒが来る前はあんまり乗り気じゃなかったじゃん」
pointers.New Text:
You weren't really into it
before Haruhi came.
pointers.MT Text:
You weren't really into it
before Haruhi came.

pointers.Original Text: 「まあね～。ほら、僕らだけでも出来るって証明するのも楽しいかなって思ってさ」
pointers.New Text:
Well, yeah. I thought it might
be fun to prove we can do this
on our own.
pointers.MT Text:
Well, yeah. I thought it might be
fun to prove that we can do this on
our own too.

pointers.Original Text: 「だよね、光ならそう言ってくれると思ったよ。僕らの麗しい兄弟愛の前では殿だってタジタジだもんね～」
pointers.New Text:
I knew Hikaru would say that.
Even Milord is helpless before
our beautiful brotherly love.
pointers.MT Text:
I knew Hikaru would say that.
Even Milord is helpless before
our beautiful brotherly love.

pointers.Original Text: ……絶対違う意味でのタジタジだと思うけど。実際自分もこの２人にタジタジになった事例は数多いし。
pointers.New Text:
I'm sure he means helpless in a
different way. They've flustered
me plenty too.
pointers.MT Text:
I'm sure he means helpless in a
different way. They've flustered

pointers.New Text:
So we're welcoming customers as
usual?
pointers.MT Text:
...So you're saying we should
welcome customers as usual?

pointers.Original Text: 「そうなるね。だからハルヒも頑張ってよ？」
pointers.New Text:
That's how it goes. So you
better do your best too?
pointers.MT Text:
That's how it is. So Haruhi, you
better do your best too?

I'll do my best without overdoing
it.

「ああ、それと。自分は光と馨のシンメトリーな世界には付き合わないからね」

Yeah, and I'm not part of Hikaru
and Kaoru's little symmetry act.
pointers.MT Text:
Yeah, and I'm not part of Hikaru
and Kaoru's little symmetry act.

I was thinking of letting Haruhi
join too.
pointers.MT Text:
I was thinking of letting Haruhi
join too.

pointers.Original Text: 「全力でヘルプにまわらせて頂きます」
pointers.New Text: I'll do my best to help.
pointers.MT Text: I'll do my absolute best to help.

pointers.New Text:
I'll do my best since it's tied
to paying off my debt.
pointers.MT Text:
I gotta pay off my debts, so of
course I'll do my best.

pointers.Original Text: 「なんか答えが所帯じみてるよね～」

Your answer sounds so domestic and
settled down, ya know?

pointers.Original Text: 「うんうん。もっと違う理由で頑張って欲しいよね」

Yeah, yeah. I want you to try
harder for different reasons.

Yeah yeah. I want you to try harder
for different reasons.

I can do my best because I'm
with us--or something like that.

I can do my best because I'm

I was thinking of letting Haruhi

Hmm, should I try my best too? I
think it's better to have a
stopper.
pointers.MT Text:
Hmm, should I try my best too? I

Right on the money. So I'll

Right on the money. So I'll

Why not? We can do our best

Come on, Haruhi, you're not in the
mood.

Who's going to stop them if I
act on my impulses with those
two?
pointers.MT Text:
Who's going to stop them if I
act on my impulses with those
two?

Yeah. I'm not doing anything

Yeah. I'm not doing anything
bad, am I?
...I'll do my best to help out.

I'll back them up at the help

pointers.MT Text:
I'll follow them on help even if

I was thinking of putting you in

I was thinking of pulling Haruhi

Which cup should I pour tea

Which cup should I pour tea

That's right... I'll have my
afternoon tea in Wedgwood,

That's right... I'll have my
afternoon tea in Wedgwood,

I'll stay by that pillar over

pointers.MT Text:
I stay a little away from them

pointers.Original Text: 今のところ問題はない……かな。

There shouldn't be any
problems... I hope.
pointers.MT Text: So far so good... I guess.

...Getting into Victorian stuff

pointers.MT Text:
...Getting into Victorian stuff
really gets to you, huh?

Yeah, on weekends I stroll
through antique markets in
England.
pointers.MT Text:
Yeah, on weekends I stroll
through antique markets in
England.
Light... I'm fine, so don't worry

Are you sure you're okay?! Look,
your pinky's all red and
swollen...
pointers.MT Text:
Are you sure that's okay? Look, your
little finger is all red and
swollen...

pointers.Original Text: 「恥ずかしいなら僕が抱き込んで顔を隠してあげるから……」
pointers.New Text:
If you're embarrassed, I'll hug
you and hide your face...
pointers.MT Text:
If you're embarrassed, I'll hug you
and cover your face...

pointers.Original Text: 「さあ、キッチンで指を冷やそう。あまり僕に心配をかけさせるなよ」

Come on, let's cool off your
fingers in the kitchen. Don't
worry me too much.
pointers.MT Text:
C'mon, let's cool off your fingers
in the kitchen. Don't worry me too
much.

pointers.New Text: It's a feast for the eyes!
pointers.MT Text: Wow, what a treat for the eyes!

pointers.Original Text: 「あの、代えの紅茶は自分が注ぎますので暫くお待ち下さい」

Um, I'll pour your replacement
tea in a moment, please wait.
pointers.MT Text:
Um, I'll pour your replacement tea
in a moment, so please wait just a
bit.

pointers.Original Text: ……と、ここまではまだ良かったんだ。そう、ここまではいつも通りの行き過ぎた兄弟愛？で。

Up till now, all good. Just
usual overprotective brothers?

Up till now, all good. Just

pointers.New Text:
When that fails... I learned
firsthand just how bad things
can get.
pointers.MT Text:
When that fails... I learned
firsthand just how bad things
can get.

pointers.Original Text: 「馨！　それは僕が持って行くって言っただろ！」
pointers.New Text: Kaoru! Didn't I say I'd take it!
pointers.MT Text: Kaoru! Didn't I say I'd take it!

pointers.Original Text: 「でも、光にばっかり任せてるのも……」
pointers.New Text:
But leaving it all to Hikaru
isn't...
pointers.MT Text:
But leaving it all to Hikaru
isn't...

pointers.New Text:
You're hurt, right? You should
just rest.
pointers.MT Text:
You're hurt, right? You should just

pointers.Original Text: 「やだよ、僕だって光の役にたちたい！」
pointers.New Text:
No way! I want to help Hikaru
too!
pointers.MT Text:
No way! I want to help Hikaru

Kaoru... I'm happy, but just
watch me. I don't want you hurt

Kaoru... I'm happy, but just

After that, their overzealous

Your order was just the scones,

Sure. Um, if it's not too much
trouble, could I get another
Darjeeling?
pointers.MT Text:
Sure. Um, if it's not too much
trouble, could I get another
Darjeeling?

Kaoru! You just burned yourself

refill, so you take the scone!
pointers.MT Text:
Kaoru! You just burned yourself with

I'm not a kid anymore, so I
won't make the same mistake over
and over.

I'm not a kid anymore, so I

It's not about failing... Just

You're worrying too much. I'm
not that stupid to mess up so
many times.

Koumachi, you worry too much. I'm
not that stupid to mess up so many

Free twins cause trouble;

You're the one who can't sleep
